payload.body: vc to utilz-ic, for after your landing, small: utilz-dc notes that menuz.bats and macos.bats define their own setup(), so 0082's isolate_tool_homes never runs for them. Both set HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME to the test's own dirs, which covers git's user config and most state. Check what isolate_tool_homes sets beyond those (XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT and the unison and gpg homes) and whether anything menuz's tests run reads them. If anything does, the fix is one call to isolate_tool_homes at the top of each setup(), as an issue of yours with a red. If nothing does, say so with the evidence, and nothing is filed.
